latest.title: Energy identity for Intrinsic Stationary Biharmonic Mappings into Homogeneous Spaces in Supercritical Dimensions
latest.abstract: In this paper, we consider energy identity for intrinsic stationary biharmonic maps into homogeneous spaces in supercritical dimensions, extending the corresponding result of Hornung-Moser [Anal. PDE. 2012] in critical dimension. The proof follows a similar strategy as that of Lin-Rivière [Duke Math. J. 2002]. A key ingredient is a conservation law for intrinsic biharmonic maps into homogeneous spaces, which allow us to derive higher regularity of the map.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究齐次黎曼靶流形上的 stationary intrinsic biharmonic maps，建立守恒律并构造 bubble。
latest.breakthrough: Theorems 1.2–1.3 给出守恒律结构，Theorem 3.1 构造第一个非平凡 bubble。
latest.limitations: 靶流形需紧致齐次；bubble 构造依赖非零通量/集中参数。

steps.claim: Lemmas 2.4–2.6 构造齐次靶流形上的 Killing 场代数表示。
steps.route: 用齐次空间的 Killing 场覆盖切空间，建立与映射导数配对的代数恒等式。

steps.claim: Theorem 1.3 的 conservation law 由 Killing 场恒等式推出。
steps.route: 把变分方程与 Killing 场代入，构造散度为零的二阶张量；对测试场积分得到守恒量。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–7页，第2.2节 Proof of Theorem 1.3。

steps.claim: Theorem 3.1 通过集中缩放构造 first bubble。
steps.route: 选取能量集中点，按尺度 rescale 映射并用守恒律排除能量流失，得到非恒定极限 bubble；Section 4 再提升正则性。
steps.evidence: PDF 第18–24页，第3节 Theorem 3.1；第27页起第4节 Higher regularity via conservation law。
